comment: Shared behaviour vectors for the local text filter (docs/design/rename-and-content-safety.md 6.3). Both server versions must satisfy every case. scene is the action class: name (names and labels), notice (guild announcement), chat. The built-in impersonation words (官方, 客服, 管理员, 系统, 运营 as substrings; gm as a prefix) are always present and are not listed in deny.
